name: Gayan Shanaka Thejawansha
headline: Lead Software Engineer & Information Security Manager
eyebrow: Engineering leadership · Platform architecture · Information security
summary: Lead Software Engineer and Information Security Manager with more than seven years of experience designing, modernizing, and securing commerce, advertising technology, and telecommunications platforms. Combines hands-on backend, data, and infrastructure engineering with technical leadership, delivery ownership, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022-aligned security governance across cloud and bare-metal environments.
cvHighlights: Increased merchant catalogue ingestion throughput by 5× and reduced feed processing latency by 70% across commerce and advertising technology platforms.
Identified and remediated more than 17 critical infrastructure risks while establishing ISO/IEC 27001:2022-aligned security governance and technical controls.
Led telecom charging modernization across Online Charging System upgrades, prepaid fixed-line services, USSD integration, and microservices-based platforms.
Strengthened delivery through architecture leadership, code reviews, engineering mentoring, CI/CD, observability, and cross-functional technical decision-making.
heroSummary: An engineer at heart and hands-on technical leader connecting platform architecture, reliable delivery, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022-aligned security.
about: I work where software architecture, operational reliability, and information security meet. My background spans telecom charging systems, high-volume merchant data and reporting platforms, API integrations, containerized infrastructure, and security-management systems.

An engineer at heart, I stay close to implementation while leading technical direction: shaping architecture, reviewing code, improving delivery systems, mentoring engineers, translating risk into practical controls, and partnering with product and business stakeholders.

roles.title: Information Security Manager
roles.summary: Owns the strategic development and operation of the information security management system while continuing to support engineering leadership, including the identification and remediation of more than 17 critical infrastructure risks.
bullets: Leads the design and operation of an ISO/IEC 27001:2022-aligned ISMS, including organizational context, security objectives, risk treatment, internal audit coordination, and management reporting.
Established a structured risk assessment and treatment register that translates technical findings into prioritized controls, accountable owners, and measurable remediation actions.

Automates and enforces security controls across Linux and Windows environments, focusing on access control, malware protection, encryption, privilege management, firewall configuration, and network auditing.
Coordinates engineering, information security governance, business continuity, data protection, and security awareness requirements across cloud and bare-metal infrastructure.
Developed server fleet energy monitoring and operational reporting to improve infrastructure efficiency and management visibility.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer / Technical Lead
roles.summary: Leads architecture and delivery for commerce and advertising technology services, increasing merchant catalogue ingestion throughput by 5× and reducing feed processing latency by 70% across onboarding, reporting, and partner integrations.
bullets: Directs architecture and implementation for merchant catalogue ingestion, reporting services, and Google and Microsoft Shopping integrations.
Builds backend services and data workflows with PHP/Symfony, Python, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, and Redis across Docker and Kubernetes environments.
Introduced and enhanced GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, structured logging, metrics, and tracing practices to enable faster and safer production changes.
Diagnosed and resolved recurring Nginx and PHP-FPM container stability issues through profiling, configuration tuning, service hardening, and operational automation.
Developed data pipelines for campaign clicks, advertising costs, conversions, and revenue signals used by internal CPC optimization systems.
Leads sprint planning, code reviews, technical decision-making, and engineering mentoring while collaborating with product and commercial stakeholders.

Contributed to application modernization, digital transformation, cloud migration, and microservices adoption for prepaid lending and charging platforms.
Translated stakeholder requirements and production insights into architecture decisions, technical roadmaps, and service improvement plans.

caseStudies.title: Merchant data and reporting platform

caseStudies.outcome: Increased merchant catalogue throughput by 5× and reduced feed processing latency by 70%, while improving release safety and production visibility.

caseStudies.title: Security governance to technical controls

caseStudies.outcome: Identified and remediated 17+ critical infrastructure risks while establishing accountable treatment, stronger technical enforcement, and management-ready reporting.

caseStudies.title: Engineering leadership as a delivery system
caseStudies.challenge: Scale delivery and ownership across evolving platforms without losing implementation quality, reliability, or engineering context.
caseStudies.approach: Combined hands-on architecture with sprint planning, technical decision-making, code review, mentoring, CI/CD, observability, and cross-functional alignment.
caseStudies.outcome: Created shorter feedback loops, safer production changes, clearer technical direction, and a stronger engineering culture around shared ownership.
